$comment: PUBLIC placeholder identities only — replace with real addresses before live use. No private keys, mnemonics, gift codes or authenticated URLs here. Private keys come from environment variables (see .env.example).

reader._comment: READER_ROOT = (rootOwner, rootTopic). This pair NEVER changes across publisher rotation. rootOwner must equal successionAuthority.address (the authority owns the root feed).

funding._comment: Owns/manages postage batches. Must differ from publisher.address and successionAuthority.address.

publisher._comment: Current publisher. Signs catalogue feed updates. Rotated by the succession authority, never by itself.

successionAuthority._comment: Owns the root feed. The ONLY identity that can authorise a publisher change.

bee._comment: Readers need only this URL plus the reader.rootOwner/rootTopic pair.
